summary: Iteration 62: Meta Conversions API (CAPI v25.0) integration end-to-end tested. Backend 9/9 pytest passed — /api/meta/status (admin-only, masks pixel+token), /api/meta/test (fires real Purchase to Meta, status=200, events_received=1), lead-create hook (Lead event logged with ok=true within 1s), order-create hook (Purchase event logged with ok=true), events sorted desc, TC gets 403 everywhere. Frontend: admin can navigate to Data Connections tab, panel renders Connected badge, masked pixel (69086365…4240) + token (EAAOeB…ZDZD), totals populate (10 accepted, 0 rejected), test event fires with success toast, event log shows real Lead+Purchase rows. Non-admin (TC) cannot see the tab. Login <0.5s. PII hashing verified live: phone/name/country all 64-char SHA-256 hex in arrays, raw values absent.

minor.issue: create_lead does NOT persist customer email/city/state/pincode from request body. As a result, Meta Lead events only include hashed ph/fn/country — em/ct/st/zp are missing, weakening Meta's match rate. Enhancement, not a bug in Meta module itself.

action_items: OPTIONAL enhancement: In server.py create_lead (line ~1731), also persist email, customer_city, customer_state, customer_pincode fields from data.get() into the lead doc, so Meta Lead events carry hashed em/ct/st/zp for higher match quality. Order create already stores customer_email/city/state/pincode correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: meta_module.py: global _TEST_EVENT_CODE mutation in /meta/test is not thread-safe under concurrent admin calls; consider passing test_event_code as a parameter through _post_events instead of mutating module-level state (edge case, low risk since it's admin-only).

server.py hook (line 1751-1755): fire_lead_event/fire_purchase_event called with request=None — client_ip and client_user_agent are always empty in Meta payload. Passing the Request object (FastAPI Depends) would improve Meta's advanced matching (ip + UA) which materially improves ad optimization. Currently silent PII-only match.
meta_module.fire_lead_event references uuid_short which is defined AFTER it in the file — works because it's only called at runtime, but a top-level import-order refactor risk. Cosmetic.
test_credentials: Used admin@celestaglow.com / admin123 and telecaller1@celestaglow.com / tc123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 real Lead + Purchase events on Meta live (via /api/meta/test and lead/order create hooks). Test leads use TEST_ prefix in name and random 9988xxxxxx phones.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meta CAPI is live and firing real events to graph.facebook.com/v25.0. Recent events log shows 10+ successful events with fbtrace_id. If /api/leads/create is enhanced to store email/city/pincode, re-run TestLeadHook and re-enable the em/ct/zp assertions currently commented out.
rca of the issue: Missing em/ct/st/zp in Lead events → root cause is create_lead endpoint doesn't extract these fields from request body (only phone, name, source, product_interest, remarks are stored). Fix: extend the `lead` dict in server.py line 1731-1745 to include data.get('email'), data.get('customer_city'), data.get('customer_state'), data.get('customer_pincode'). Meta module already correctly reads these keys.
